messages:
Mia: Morning! finally finished assembling my standing+ treadmill desk. feels like I can ship models and cardio at the same time. pic: https://i.imgur.com/xyzAbc1.jpg :tada:
Chris: whoa treadmill desk — how fast do you go? also that's a huge mug :sweat_smile:
Mia: honestly like 2.5 mph for meetings, 3.5 if i'm pretending to be at the olympics. mug is 'code fuel' from my sister. :coffee:
Jun: heads up — we had a ~15min internet blip around 9:12am. ISP said "maintenance" which is engineering speak for "oops". got everyone rerouted to my phone hotspot.
Priya: ugh that happened to me last week. what hotspot do you use? is it awful on data?
Tom: i keep a spare LTE router (Netgear Nighthawk). plug it in, it just works. pro tip: set a separate ssid like "RI-failover" so you can auto-fallback with macOS network priorities.
Jun: Tom's advice = golden. my phone hotspot cost ~200MB during that 15m but saved a standup. also did a router reboot (`sudo reboot` — jk) :joy:
Alex: also love the treadmill pic, cat photobomb incoming? :cat2:
Mia: cat did try to walk across the keyboard during setup, webcam caught it and the meeting got 3x more productive. updated pic here: https://i.imgur.com/xyzAbc1_v2.jpg :laughing:
Chris: quick Q — anyone recommend a cheap but stable tripod/clamp for laptop webcams? mine wobbles during keyboard clacks.
Priya: i use a GorillaPod + small clamp on my shelf. cheap and holds a laptop or phone fine. link: https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00YD5H6LY (not an ad)
Tom: also, if you're on 2.4GHz and living in an apartment, the channel overlap is murder. moved my AP to 5GHz channel 36 and latency dropped for calls.
Mia: omg that helped me too. turned off channel 6 and moved to 36 — zoom + music both fine now.
Jun: ISPBot: Scheduled maintenance in your area finished at 2024-07-31T09:14:22Z. Service restored.
Chris: lol ISPBot to the rescue.
Priya: poll: is it acceptable to do a 30-min treadmill walk during async calls? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.
Alex: :thumbsup: (i walk during standups sometimes, pays more attention than caffeine)
Mia: :thumbsup: (depends on camera angle, keep the pyjama bottoms minimal)
Tom: :thumbsdown: (i once lost a sock on camera and regret everything)
Jun: ok results noted. i'll keep my sock situation under control. :sweat_smile: \nMia: thanks for the backup ISP tips everyone. i'll keep the spare router next to my desk and maybe a cat leash. :laughing:
